Metadata.title: Balsara's Risk of Ruin Simulator | Delver Tools
Metadata.description: Calculate Risk of Ruin instantly from win rate, R/R, and risk per trade. Essential for FX risk management.

Balsara.title: Balsara's Risk of Ruin Simulator
Balsara.description: Estimate ruin probability based on win rate, R/R, risk per trade, and number of trials (client-side calculation). 'Ruin' here means capital falling below <ruinFrac>{ruinFrac}%</ruinFrac>.

cards.chart: Risk of Ruin vs. Risk Rate

result.limitLabel: Ruin Threshold: Less than {val}% of initial capital
result.disclaimer: * Approx: Loss-streak based, independent trials, fixed f. For educational use only.

verdicts.warning: ⚠ Warning (Risk of ruin under certain conditions)

cta.title: Verify risk of ruin with real backtests
cta.description: Get win rate, R/R, and drawdown from a backtest, then cross-check with this calculator. Delver runs free backtests with no login.

Chart.title: Risk of Ruin vs Risk Fraction f (other parameters fixed)
Chart.footnote: Approximation: losing-streak model, independent trials, fixed f. Hover to see exact values.

EV.title: FX Expected Value (EV) Checker
EV.subtitle: Calculate expected value per trade from win rate, RR, risk fraction and costs (R-based / account %).

notes.cost: Costs in bps are converted to R using risk fraction f (smaller f makes costs heavier).
notes.howto1: • If EV < 0, the strategy is not worth testing
notes.howto2: • Small EV can easily turn negative due to costs and execution noise

RunButton.noEntry: Please set at least one entry condition.

fields.allowPyramidDesc: When ON, each new signal in the same direction adds another entry. When OFF, only one position at a time.
fields.fixedLotDesc: Trade with a constant lot size regardless of account balance (e.g. 0.1 lot)
fields.dynamicLotDesc: Lot size changes with account balance, enabling compounding

items.backtest: All backtest results are simulations based on historical data and do not guarantee future profits. Actual market conditions (fees, slippage, liquidity, trading restrictions, etc.) may differ.
items.timeframe: For lower timeframes (M1, M5, M15), the data volume is extremely large, so backtesting and chart rendering may take longer. Please do not close the screen while processing.
items.engine: This tool processes price movements bar by bar from entry to exit to calculate P&L, drawdown, win rate, and holding time. It does not use black-box AI inference, only verifiable "price action + rule logic."
items.free: The DELVER Backtest Engine is currently completely free to use. If any future pricing or limitations are introduced, we will notify you in advance.
items.contact: If you encounter bugs, have feature requests, or questions, feel free to contact us at info@delvertrade.com.

Explanation.title: How to Use Delver (3 Steps)
Explanation.description: No sign-up required. Enter your conditions in the form above and click Run to start a backtest.

steps.title: Set your conditions
steps.description: Choose rules for pair, timeframe, entry, and exit. You can also set indicator thresholds and time filters.

steps.title: Click Run
steps.description: Click Run to start the backtest. It usually finishes in under a minute. You will be taken to the results page when done.

steps.title: View and share results
steps.description: Review the summary, equity curve, and trade list. You can copy a link to share your results.
